name: io.github.MaxEllis/orcaslicer-mcp
description: Work a running OrcaSlicer with AI: slice, tune, and understand what each setting costs

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: OrcaSlicer Remote API address; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:13130

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_MCP_ALLOW_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated config keys the MCP may change even though they run code or drive the printer directly (post_process, *_gcode, print host settings). Wildcards allowed. Blank by default.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_PRINTER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional printer address; by default the address in OrcaSlicer's active printer profile is used. A user name and password can be part of it (http://user:password@192.0.2.10); percent-encode special characters in them (@ as %40). A password in it is stored as an ordinary setting, so prefer ORCA_PRINTER_API_KEY where the printer accepts a key.

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_PRINTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for printers that need one (OctoPrint, or Moonraker with authorization).

environmentVariables.name: ORCA_PRINTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional printer name for the outcome store; defaults to the host name of ORCA_PRINTER_URL when that is set, otherwise the printer profile's name, otherwise unknown.
